pages.8: Reset defaults: PWR_MGMT_1=0x40, WHO_AM_I=0x68, other described registers0
pages.12: Sample rate derived from gyro output divided by1+SMPLRT_DIV; accel1kHz
pages.13: DLPF1 gives gyro1kHz/188Hz/1.9ms, accel184Hz/2.0ms; EXT_SYNC_SET0 disables injected FSYNC bit
pages.27-29: INT_RD_CLEAR0 only clears on INT_STATUS read; DATA_RDY_EN enables event; status clears on read
pages.30-32: Sensor internal and user-facing shadows; idle duplicates internal data; burst sensor bytes coherent; signed16 data, scaling
pages.39-40: USER_CTRL bit7/3 reserved; FIFO/master off; MPU6050 I2C_IF_DIS always0; reset bits self-clear
pages.41-43: Power1 clock/wake/reset; reset bit self-clears without stated time bound; keep chosen reference gyro active
pages.46: WHO_AM_I exactly0x68; AD0 not reflected; bit7/0 hardcoded0
